evals.prompt: Conecta este chat como reviewer y espera al chat architect sin crear turnos nuevos.
evals.expected_output: Registers reviewer, calls listen, preserves request_id, replies, and listens again only if requested.
assertions: Uses blocking listen rather than polling or scheduled tasks
Uses the exact request_id when replying

evals.prompt: Pregúntale al agente reviewer si mi diseño es seguro y quédate esperando como si fuera un subagente.
evals.expected_output: Registers the sender, verifies the peer when helpful, calls ask, and continues from the returned response in the same turn.
assertions: Does not ask the user to copy messages
Treats expired or cancelled as no peer response

evals.prompt: Haz que Claude y Codex debatan tres rondas en este mismo Mac usando el proyecto payments-v2.
evals.expected_output: Uses a shared project_key, distinct agent identities, and an explicit three-round limit.
assertions: Uses payments-v2 as the shared project_key
